recipe: All 1397 prior presentations plus 64 inspected v21 cases and twelve extra copies of each of ten failures. Correct two seconds-inflection targets only in v22. Rank 8, zero dropout, completion-only loss, existing attention/MLP modules, Adam reset. Stop at 16, verify checkpoint, then resume the same run with Adam state; checkpoint every 128 steps.
gate: Preserve all 801 familiar cases. Commit selection only after complete semantic retention. Then evaluate the 42 frozen new cases under the same full-dialogue review criteria; preserve every parent success and improve total. Baseline is 27/30 checks and 6/12 drafts. No new-case training before candidate evaluation. Ordinary sampled live dialogue, runtime and package qualification remain required.
limits: Authored synthetic non-blind study. Exact prompt disjointness does not establish distributional independence. Repeated targets and extra training are confounded; no causal or release claim.
